zh.explain: 云雾笼罩，前途迷茫，春尽花谢又再开。如果现在的酣梦能被诗书唤醒，再遇贵人指引便必定能步入仙境。（“天台”指天宫或天台山。）
divination: 若是老年人求得此签，则会获得第二春。
想要求问功名利禄，则要晚年才可获得意外的财富。
items: 宜多用功，没有不劳而获
zh.summary: 此封春尽花开之象。所祈求之事会在以后的某时有所改善。

verse: Dark clouds and fogs shroud the mountain path.
Flowers wither and bloom again when spring is nearing its end.
As families unite, the moon is full again.
If you wake now from a deep poetic dream,
You will be led to the steps of Heaven.
interpretation: The aged will bloom again as what remains after Spring does.
If you seek fame and fortune, you may claim a large fortune in later years.
meaning: End of Spring as flowers bloom.
Things will prove promising in the end after a change.
en.explain: Dark clouds and mist shroud the road ahead, the future is indistinct, flowers wither and bloom again when spring is nearing its end. If you can wake up from your current poetic dream, and once again receive a nobleman’s guidance, then you will surely enter into a Heavenly paradise.
divination: If an elderly person receives this lot, he or she will have a second chance at romance. If you seek fame and wealth, then you may get unexpected fortune in your later years.
items: Need to put in efforts to get returns
Work harder, there is nothing for free
Put in all efforts to achieve

notes: zh shiyi and summary print 此封 (封, likely typo for 卦; confirmed by zoom), copied as printed. zh explain includes the printed parenthetical gloss （“天台”指天宫或天台山。）. Extra item 迁徙搬家 / 'Migrating and moving house' on both pages; zh key 畜养动物; en key 'Traveller'. en Lot Verse has 5 clauses (extra line 'As families unite, the moon is full again.' with no zh counterpart). en section label printed 'Divination of The' (missing 'Lot').
